name: What is the difference between a two-story addition and a pop-top addition?
description: A two-story addition expands both horizontally and vertically, while a pop-top adds a new story atop the existing footprint without ground-level expansion.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a two-story addition and a pop-top addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A two-story addition typically extends the home's footprint both horizontally and vertically, creating new ground-floor and second-story space. A pop-top addition, however, involves removing the existing roof and adding an entire new story (or more) on top of the existing first floor, without significantly expanding the ground-level footprint. Choosing between these depends on available yard space and desired living area configuration.
